conventions.cash_low: Minimum among observed command-boundary samples, including the initial state; not transient cash inside a command
conventions.transaction_cash_low: Minimum of boundary cash and cash before/after newly appended ledger transactions. Excludes pre-study ledger history; does not infer unrecorded intermediate cash.
conventions.calendar: Last observed sample at each shared run_cycle; zero-cycle actions use their final observed boundary at that cycle. No interpolation, extrapolation or assumption of equal phase.
conventions.release: First post-command sample attaining each new release ordinal; compared launch milestones may occur at different calendar cycles
conventions.censoring: Failed/bounded cases retain their observed prefix. Missing releases are unobserved, never zero-valued. No rejected action means none observed, not proof of no financial blocker.
conventions.integrity: Local source/input/artifact consistency checks; no signatures or malicious-tampering guarantee. Variant tapes are not decoded here; use the separate exact replay command.
conventions.scope: Independent campaigns; no winner, balance approval, human feel or shared-world AI claim

right.termination_error: The run calendar cannot advance safely.

first_rejected_action.error: The run calendar cannot advance safely.

right.rejection_observation: recorded command rejection; inspect its error, not every rejection is financial
